name: Computers
description: Linux computers with a web browser, on your own Fly.io, E2B or Google Cloud account. Rebel can create them, run commands and scripts, install software, copy files to and from your Library, use websites in the computer's own browser, and save scripts as tools to reuse. Computers keep their files and sign-ins, stop by themselves when idle, and are billed by your cloud provider. 'Set up a computer and turn this spreadsheet into charts every Monday'.
